author: claude
summary: Hardens ChapterWorkspaceHeader's existing chapter-switcher dropdown (ChapterDropdown) to full ARIA listbox semantics, per contextual-left-nav task 002 / INV-NAV-3/5/6/7/8: role=listbox/option (was menu/menuitem), initial focus-on-open, a single authoritative close path (Escape-keydown owns it; wrapper-blur is a guarded fallback, not a second independent trigger), real DOM focus + scrollIntoView on arrow-key nav (verified against a 120-chapter fixture via a scrollIntoView spy), a scoped aria-live status-change announcement, 44x44px effective hit areas on the trigger/nav-buttons/option rows, and explicit :focus-visible styling distinct from the active/selected indicator. No change to data flow (still reads chapters/jobs as props from BookLayout), the trigger button's label, or the dropdown's position in the header.

files.change: ChapterDropdown converted from role=menu/menuitem <button> rows to role=listbox/option <div> rows with aria-selected + roving tabindex. Parent gained focusedIndex state, optionRefs/listboxRef/triggerRef, a closingRef-guarded closeDropdown() as the single close path (Escape keydown + wrapper-blur fallback both route through it), effects for initial-focus-on-open, focus+scrollIntoView on every focusedIndex change, chapters-identity clamping while open, and a scoped aria-live 'polite' status-change announcement. Trigger's aria-haspopup changed from 'menu' to 'listbox'.

Bumped .chapter-workspace-header__switcher-trigger to min-height:44px, .chapter-workspace-header__nav-btn from 28x28 to 44x44 (removed the now-redundant mobile-only override), .workspace-chapter-dropdown__item to min-height:44px with increased padding, and added an explicit :focus-visible outline+background state on dropdown options distinct from the active/selected indicator.

Added a no-op Element.prototype.scrollIntoView polyfill (jsdom doesn't implement it), matching the existing window.matchMedia polyfill pattern, so components calling it during render/effects don't crash tests that don't care about scroll behavior.

New test file (18 tests): listbox semantics, initial-focus-on-open, arrow-key nav with real document.activeElement + scrollIntoView assertions, a blur/Escape race test, scoped aria-live announcements, a 120-chapter scrollIntoView-spy scale test, and a chapters-prop-identity-swap reset test plus empty/single-chapter edge cases. Revert-checked: 15/18 fail against the pre-hardening component.
Updated role queries from menu/menuitem to listbox/option to match the converted semantics; no behavioral change to the test's assertions.
Updated the two 'Contents dropdown' tests' role queries from menuitem to option to match the converted semantics; no behavioral change to the test's assertions.
